{{Quote|People thought I fought him because he was more successful. Because he made me "number two." Because he stole my wife. Lies!|Diago Hixan, on Nok Drayen|<ref name="Bugged" />}}
'''Shassa Dalle''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]]<ref name="Codex" /> who was the [[Marriage/Legends|wife]]<ref name="Bugged" /> of the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Diago Hixan]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Considered to be particularly beautiful, Dalle was the love of Hixan's life,<ref name="Codex" /> but Dalle was "stolen" by Hixan's rival [[Nok Drayen]]. Furious that Drayen had seduced his wife and ran away with her, Hixan made numerous attempts to win back Dalle from Drayen over the [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. However, his attempts ultimately caused Dalle's accidental [[Death/Legends|death]]<ref name="Codex" /> sometime before [[3653 BBY]]<ref name="Time" /> and earned Drayen Hixan's eternal hatred.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Shassa Dalle was mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], in a Codex entry for Diago Hixan and by by Hixan himself in a holorecording during the [[Smuggler/Legends|Smuggler]] class mission "Bugged-Out" on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Bugged" />
